title: Cloud City: Databases: Cloud SQL, Spanner, Firestore, and Bigtable

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Brightloaf Bakery kept recipe secrets and financial ledgers in a single notebook in the kitchen drawer. A spilled cup of coffee obliterated two years of financial history.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian built the Central Municipal Records Hall (Cloud SQL & Spanner). All transactions are recorded in synchronized vaults across multiple city gates.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: During a city earthquake, the North Vault was destroyed. The South Vault instantly assumed primary ledger authority without losing a single cent.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical archives, duplicating books takes hours; in Cloud Spanner, atomic transactions commit across continents using atomic GPS clocks.
